verdict.rationale: Bulk operations, such as acting on many threads, models or assistants at once, are a fair question for a desktop AI chat app, so the axis applies. The evidence never documents bulk selection or batch actions. The closest items are single-item imports, per-call MCP tool approvals and a general claim of autonomous agent tasks, none of which is a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
